notes.title: Another Update wooo
notes.content:
Bunch of new stuff to make the game easier, add content and replay ability, as well as try to smooth things out.

Added a level/progression system. 
Gain experience from exploring and slaying enemies. Experience is used to level up and get perks! How original! Fully leveling up grants a character specific perk.

Couple new musics because why not.

Some rebalancing for various items and such as always I end up forgetting.

Now you can hold space to skip ahead instead of waiting forever to restore energy.

Maybe some other stuff, I forget I should really start keeping track for better updates.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Option to change font in the options menu, could be hard to read when high.
Hotkey decals in combat for those who can't find them easily.
Dodging costs less energy and should be slightly easier.
Map can be accessed not just from the pause menu.
With the implementation of a map feature, thread became pretty useless, now you gain speed near thread.
Hopefully less enemies spawn near the player upon first starting a run.
Reduced the size of one of the minotaur's attacks.
I don't remember everything, but several rebalances in items and consumables.
Significant buffs to The Boy character.
Maybe some other stuff I don't remember
